messages:
maya: hey team — PR #8417 is blocked, CI failing intermittently on kv-cache tests. can someone take a quick look? failing job: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/5643  #flake
buildkite: Build 5643 failed — test_kv_cache::test_prefix_eviction (exit code 1). logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/5643#logs
liam: :eyes: i can try to reproduce. is this happening locally for you? which runner?
maya: only on linux-gpu runners for me, can't repro locally. quick log snippet: ```AssertionError: kv_cache.length (512) != expected_prefix_len (256)
  File "/workspace/tests/test_kv_cache.py", line 87, in test_prefix_eviction```
sanjeev: that test is sensitive to batching/prefix caching. we changed batcher.window to 50 in the last infra rollback — could be related.
robin: can we just rerun the job first? if it flakes again we should bisect. liam, can you kick a rerun?
liam: rerunning now :arrow_up: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/5644
buildkite: Build 5644 failed — same test (test_prefix_eviction) failed again. repeating failure.
maya: two failures in a row. i'm inclined to mark the test xfail on this PR to unblock the merge and open a follow-up issue for the flake + bisect. any objections?
sanjeev: ok to xfail temporarily if you add a TODO and file an issue linking the CI runs. also include the docker image tag and runner id from the failed job.
maya: will do. adding xfail + TODO now, filing issue and assigning to @sanjeev. merging after xfail in 10m unless someone objects. :thumbsup:
liam: sounds good, thanks for handling the follow-up.
robin: thanks — and please add the full failure log to the issue.
maya: done — PR updated with xfail and issue #1123. merging in 8m.
